purpose: Teach: フェニックス/ユビキタス/フェデラー/バレンシア/ルックス/ゴッホ/スタンフォード大/寝たきり

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、フェニックスのデザイン気に入ってたな
lines.en: You really loved that Phoenix design, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful tease with an edge underneath. Sharp attack on the opening. Quick pace, knowing smirk in the voice. Testing to see if he'll take the bait.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、技術の授業でユビキタス習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered ubiquitous computing in tech class, remember? Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting with a question instead of a direct answer. Light, almost conversational tone. Slight pause before her name — defensive repositioning, turning the tables.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、フェデラーの試合録画してたな
lines.en: You were recording Federer matches, weren't you?
lines.style: Softer probe this time, genuine curiosity breaking through the teasing. Slower pace. Less accusatory — more like she's noticing something real about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、地理でバレンシア習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied Valencia in geography, didn't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Matching her rhythm now but still deflecting. Quieter, more thoughtful. The tone shifts — he's not just parrying back. He's showing he notices things about her too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近ルックス気にしすぎだぞ
lines.en: You've been way too caught up in how you look lately.
lines.style: Sharper landing. Drops the teasing mask for a moment. Direct accusation wrapped in care. A beat of sincerity before the wry surface comes back.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、美術でゴッホの真似してたな、桜
lines.en: You were doing that Gogh imitation in art class, remember? Sakura.
lines.style: Wry deflection turning into something warmer. Slight smile in the voice. He's met her somewhere genuine, but he won't say it straight. Trailing off softly — the gentlest riposte.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、スタンフォード大に憧れてたな
lines.en: You were talking about how much you wanted to get into Stanford.
lines.style: Even softer. The teasing has almost completely dropped away. Noticing aloud without judgment. Respectful, almost tender — she knows this matters to him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祖父ちゃんが寝たきりだって心配してたな、桜
lines.en: You were worried about your grandfather being bedridden, weren't you? Sakura.
lines.style: The mask fully down now. Quiet, steady, no deflection. Tender and direct. Speaks to her concern without flinching. The kind of thing you only say when it matters.
